name: Space Jockey
author: Harris Kenny
description: Space Jockey — rocket-pilot Falcon & Starship board for Omarchy: flip-digit stats, countdown, mission detail, Watch. Unofficial. Launch data via The Space Devs (LL2).

barWidget.description: Rocket-pilot flip-digit Falcon & Starship stats, next NET countdown, mission detail, ongoing Crew Dragon, and Watch

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll Launch Library 2. Free tier is 15 req/hour — keep this ≥ 600.

schema.label: Notify at T−10 and T−0
schema.description: Opt-in desktop toasts (notify-send) once per launch id when countdown crosses T−10 (~10 min) and T−0. Off by default.

schema.label: Show mission name in bar
schema.description: Prefix the bar countdown with a short mission name (truncated).

schema.label: Sticky Watch (keep playing when hidden)
schema.description: When on, Esc / hide keeps MediaPlayer + stream-proxy running; the bar can show a playing glyph. When off (default), hide pauses Watch and stops the proxy.

schema.label: Watch stream quality
schema.description: yt-dlp height preference passed to scripts/stream-proxy.py (best | 720 | 480).

schema.label: Starfield ambience
schema.description: Faint animated starfield behind the panel (pauses while Watch is active).

schema.label: Animate flip counters
schema.description: Mechanical digit-flip animation when launch/landing/pending totals change.
